findings.title: Bound expanded identifier and structural-path text before allocation
findings.observation: The only _Keys output limit counts records. JSON child_pointer constructs a full ancestor prefix for each descendant before _Keys.add, and the adapter likewise accounts only row counts. The public parser returned 65/129/257 keys with 133559/265107/528275 UTF-8 pointer bytes from 2684/3352/4760-byte inputs, each under max_bytes=8192. These measurements do not redefine the input byte limit as an output limit: they establish that no separate aggregate text budget exists.
findings.impact: At the accepted 64 MiB document and 100000-key ceilings, repeated long prefixes permit impractical output allocations despite bounded source bytes and record counts. INI section/default-derived paths and aggregation across multiple files need the same explicit accounting.
findings.required_change: Introduce a finite documented text/identifier/pointer allocation budget; charge prospective expanded addresses before constructing them and account for complete projected output across files before rows are retained. Keep fixed redacted limit diagnostics and discard partial failed-file or aggregate-overflow claims. Do not weaken input, key-count, depth or source-provenance checks.
findings.required_proof: Retain the small long-prefix reproductions and add deterministic allocation/work assertions for over-budget path construction, multibyte/escaped identifiers, inherited INI paths, and aggregate output across files. Assert rejection before the prohibited allocation, plus ordinary supported inputs and stable identities.

findings.title: Bound or remove INI option-regex backtracking for invalid and valid lines
findings.observation: The locator invokes ConfigParser.OPTCRE and parser.read_file later uses the same permissive option grammar. The overlapping lazy option match and whitespace match repeatedly scan internal spaces. Malformed delimiter-free lines with 1024/2048/4096 spaces took about 0.005/0.019/0.078 seconds. Valid keys K + spaces + Suffix=VALUE_SENTINEL also took about 0.005/0.020/0.079 seconds and were accepted. Both samples remain below 8192 input bytes.
findings.impact: The physical-line count and total byte limits do not supply a practical aggregate parser-work bound; a single much longer permitted line can consume excessive CPU. Rejecting lines with no delimiter alone leaves the valid-line reproduction unchanged.
findings.required_change: Remove the overlapping backtracking path or establish deterministic preflight line/aggregate work limits before both locator and ConfigParser option matching. Preserve the explicitly supported strict/case-preserving/default/continuation grammar and fixed redacted errors. A delimiter-presence check alone is insufficient.
findings.required_proof: Add regressions for the exact invalid and valid whitespace cases, with operation/allocation counters or fail-before-parser seams. Include many individually admissible lines to demonstrate the aggregate bound, and positive whitespace/continuation/default cases. Do not use wall-clock timing thresholds as correctness gates.
